items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: we’ve got Mayor LaGuardia to thank for that.

ctx.x: Fantastic. Oh it was something new, and we’ve got Mayor LaGuardia to thank for that. The only hang-up was that most of the students that went there were piano players. So we all had to take another instrument. I picked up the bass violin. Stupid me. I used to carry it home every night and bring it back the next morning. I got tired of that too.
